notes: Canopy is slightly wider than the catalog ratio, but well within acceptable tabletop bounds

blind.description: A stylized, hand-painted cartoon deciduous tree. It consists of a stout, gnarly brown trunk with mossy roots flared out at the base, branching upward into several thick rounded clumps of layered vibrant green leaves forming a full canopy. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures, with no broken geometry, floating elements, or visible defects.
blind.from_above: A dense, rounded canopy of leafy green lobes resembling a head of broccoli or clustered shrubbery.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.3 to 1.5 times the height of the figure (around 7 to 8 feet tall), with a canopy width about 6 to 7 feet across.
